Website Notes
  • Any information seen on this website may be reused for any purpose. If any portion of the website is shown or referenced, crediting Michael Ferragamo would be greatly appreciated! Thank you, and enjoy!
  • The NOTABLES section for certain landfalls on the interactive landfall map is still being worked on. Expect some to list inaccurate records for the time being!
  • Capture function on the landfalls interactive may display no map tiles on certain areas, and may not work on mobile devices. Working on a fix!
@FerragamoWx @hurricaneupdate @TheHurricaneUpdate
Data across the TROPICAL CYCLONE DATABASE is powered by the Atlantic Hurricane Database (HURDAT2, 1851–2025) for all landfall positions, wind, and pressure. The database was also utilized to recover landfalls HURDAT2 didn't flag. A landfall counts if a storm’s center crosses a coastline at tropical storm strength or above. This website is built as a reference and educational tool, so as always, confirm figures/decisions against the National Hurricane Center’s official reports.
